bullets.title: Ultra-Powerful Charging Station
bullets.text: Experience the convenience of powering six devices at once with Anker Prime charging station's ultra-powerful 200W output.

bullets.title: Each USB-C Supports 100W Max
bullets.text: When using two USB-C ports simultaneously, each can provide up to 100W of power, transforming charging times for high-demand devices. Charge two 14″ MacBook Pros to 50% in just 28 minutes.

bullets.title: 6 Devices, 1 Charger
bullets.text: Power 6 devices simultaneously in one convenient location, ensuring all your tech is ready and fully charged.

bullets.title: The Charger That Protects
bullets.text: Anker's exclusive MultiProtect and ActiveShield 3.0 system deliver comprehensive safety, continuously monitoring charging temperatures to ensure your devices charge safely.

bullets.title: What You Get
bullets.text: Anker Prime Charger (200W, 6 Ports, GaN), 5 ft AC power cord, welcome guide, 12-month warranty, and our friendly customer service.

bullets.title: 15W Qi2 Super Fast Charging
bullets.text: Maximize your time with this ultra-fast 15W Qi2 wireless charger, making low battery warnings a thing of the past. Power an iPhone 15 Pro from 0 to 30% in just 24 minutes. (Note: Tested under ideal lab conditions. Actual charging times may vary with usage, environment, and device status.)

bullets.title: Dual Functionality Charger
bullets.text: Simplify your space with a versatile 2-in-1 charging solution, perfectly designed to power both your iPhone and AirPods, keeping your desktop clean and organized.

bullets.title: Adjust Your View
bullets.text: Easily adjust the viewing angle from 50° to 70° vertically and rotate 360° horizontally to find your perfect viewing position while charging.

bullets.title: Sophisticated and User-Friendly
bullets.text: Integrate aesthetically pleasing design and practical functionality with this wireless charging dock, crafted for both visual appeal and user comfort.

bullets.title: What You Get
bullets.text: Anker MagGo Wireless Charger (2-in-1, Dock Stand), 5 ft USB-C to USB-C cable, welcome guide, 12-month warranty, and our friendly customer service.

bullets.title: Slimmest Power Yet
bullets.text: At just 0.58 × 2.78 × 4.09 inches thick, achieve maximum portability and power with our slimmest design to date. (Note: Based on internal comparisons with previous Anker models.)

bullets.title: Ultra-Fast 15W Wireless Charging
bullets.text: Keep your devices fully charged wherever you go with 15W Qi2-certified wireless output, which charges an iPhone 15 Pro from 0 to 50% in 51 minutes. It also features a 30W USB-C port for extensive compatibility.

bullets.title: Ergonomic Design, Enhanced Portability
bullets.text: Combines a matte UV finish and a sturdy metal frame for a superior user experience, enhanced by aerogel thermal insulation to keep it cool to the touch.

bullets.title: 10,000mAh High-Capacity Power
bullets.text: Ideal for both daily use and travel, this power bank offers ample capacity, providing 1.8 full charges for an iPhone 15 Pro.

bullets.title: What You Get
bullets.text: Anker MagGo Power Bank (10K, Slim), 23.62″ / 60 cm USB-C to USB-C cable, welcome guide, 12-month warranty, and our friendly customer service.

bullets.title: Ultra-fast wireless charging with 15W power
bullets.text: This 15W car charger is designed for the latest iPhone models and offers an incomparably fast charging speed. An iPhone 15 Pro will be delivered in just 16 minutes. charged to 20% battery.

bullets.title: ADJUSTABLE PAD WITH MAGNETIC 360 DEGREE STATION
bullets.text: No more cumbersome charging. The angle of the charging pad can be adjusted to your needs and tilted and rotated at a 360° angle.

bullets.title: On the spots, ready, go
bullets.text: The all-in-one car charging kit includes a 1.5 m long built-in USB-C cable, a cable organiser and a powerful 25 W adapter.

bullets.title: Charger with extremely strong magnets
bullets.text: even on bumpy roads, you don't have to worry about your phone. The magnet is so strong that your phone is held firmly with every shock.

bullets.title: What You Get
bullets.text: Anker MagGo wireless car charger 15W (pad, built-in USB-C cable), 1.5 m USB-C to USB-C cable, 25 W USB-C adapter, cable organiser, 12-month warranty, quick start guide.

bullets.title: Flexible Fit
bullets.text: Sport X20 workout earbuds come equipped with adjustable ear hooks that can be extended and rotated for a comfortable and secure fit. Up to 30 degrees rotation and 4mm extension, customize the position to fit you perfectly.

bullets.title: Get More Focus
bullets.text: Sport X20 workout earbuds deliver powerful noise cancelling, turning loud gyms into peaceful areas. Block out distracting sounds — from clanging weights to loud grunts. Manual adjustment and adaptive ANC keep you focused on your fitness goals.

bullets.title: Pump Up Your Bass
bullets.text: Experience the pulse-pounding thrill of soundcore's BassUp technology, fueled by powerful 11mm dynamic drivers. Elevate your audio adventure to take your motivation to a new level.

bullets.title: Everything-Proof Design
bullets.text: The sport earbuds' unique cavity design and soundcore exclusive SweatGuard technology create a submarine-inspired seal that protects the internal components against damage from water, sweat, and dust. Move without fear.

bullets.title: 20-Hour Ultra playback time
bullets.text: Enjoy up to 20 hours of non-stop music on a single charge, perfect for extended outdoor adventures and all-day gatherings.

bullets.title: 5W Surprisingly Punchy Sound
bullets.text: Despite its compact size, this bluetooth speaker delivers powerful and punchy sound with 5W output, ensuring clear and dynamic audio performance.

bullets.title: IP67 Full Protection and Floating
bullets.text: Rated IP67 for full protection against dust and water, this outdoor speaker is designed to withstand harsh outdoor conditions and can even float, making it ideal for river parties and beach trips.

bullets.title: Light weight & strap design
bullets.text: The lightweight design and included strap make it easy to carry the outdoor speaker anywhere, whether you're hiking, biking, or just on the go.

bullets.title: Wireless Stereo Pairing(TWS)
bullets.text: Enable True Wireless Stereo (TWS) pairing to connect two speakers wirelessly for an enhanced, immersive sound experience with stereo separation.

bullets.title: Hybrid Active Noise Cancelling
bullets.text: 2 internal and 2 external mics work in tandem to detect external noise and effectively reduce up to 90% of it, such as planes and car engines.

bullets.title: Immerse Yourself in Detailed Audio
bullets.text: The noise cancelling headphones have oversized 40mm dynamic drivers that produce detailed sound and thumping beats with BassUp technology. Compatible with Hi-Res certified audio via the AUX cable for more detail.

bullets.title: 40-Hour Long Battery Life and Fast Charging
bullets.text: With 40 hours of battery life with ANC on and 60 hours in normal mode, you can commute in peace with your Bluetooth headphones without thinking about recharging. Fast charge for 5 mins to get an extra 4 hours of playtime.

bullets.title: Dual-Connections
bullets.text: Connect to two devices simultaneously with Bluetooth 5.0 and instantly switch between them. Whether you're working on your laptop, or need to take a phone call, audio from your Bluetooth headphones will automatically play from the device you need to hear from.

bullets.title: App for EQ Customization
bullets.text: Download the soundcore app to tailor your sound using the customizable EQ, with 22 presets, or adjust it yourself. You can also switch between 3 modes: ANC, Normal, and Transparency, and relax with white noise.

bullets.title: Hear Your Surroundings
bullets.text: Switch to Transparency mode on your noise cancelling headphones when you need to be aware of your surroundings, such as transportation announcements, crossing the road, or just staying connected to the world around you.

bullets.title: Foldable Like No Other
bullets.text: soundcore-engineered FlexiCurve Structure reduces the size by 50%. Space One Pro Noise Cancelling Headphones' compact and foldable design lets you pack more.

bullets.title: Exclusive 4-Stage Noise Cancelling System
bullets.text: Enhanced and improved, soundcore's Space One Pro Noise Cancelling Headphones target and cancel out a wider range of on-the-go noise in real time, adapting to your dynamic movements.

bullets.title: Rich, Lossless Listening Experience
bullets.text: Space One Pro's advanced drivers feature triple composite diaphragms for perfect audio balance and LDAC mode for Hi-Res audio. Indulge in high-fidelity, undistorted audio with less than 3% Total Harmonic Distortion.

bullets.title: 60 Hours Nonstop Playback with Ultra-Fast Charging
bullets.text: Enjoy audio that lasts for days, with ultra-fast charging for 8 hours of playback in just 5 minutes. Space One Pro boasts an impressive 40H battery life with ANC on, and 60H with ANC off.

bullets.title: Enhanced Protection
bullets.text: Crafted from premium synthetic materials, providing a soft protective shell for your music partner. Rest easy knowing your headphones are safe from scuffs and scratches.

bullets.title: Compact with Massive Power
bullets.text: Power devices with 300W (600W Surge) The 288Wh battery supports 140W two-way USB-C fast charging.

bullets.title: 7 Device Charging Ports
bullets.text: Power all your tech on the go with versatility, no matter the connection type.

bullets.title: Travel-Friendly Design
bullets.text: 15% smaller than similar power stations, attach the strap (sold separately) to easily carry your power.

bullets.title: 100W Solar Input
bullets.text: Give your journey endless charging with up to 100W solar recharging.

bullets.title: 4 Ways to Recharge
bullets.text: Recharge to 80% in just 50 minutes with a wall outlet. You can also use solar panels, your car, or the PD 3.1 USB-C port.

bullets.title: Long-Lasting Power
bullets.text: Power up for a decade thanks to LFP batteries. Your purchase is also backed by a 5-year warranty.

bullets.title: Smart App Control
bullets.text: Give your power intelligent customization via the Anker app. Connect with Bluetooth or Wi-Fi.

bullets.title: Quiet 25dB Power
bullets.text: Rest while you power in nature. This power station only emits 25dB from 1 m away.

bullets.text: Anker SOLIX C300 Portable Power Station, AC Charging Cable, Safety Manual, and Warranty Info.

bullets.text: Anker SOLIX F3800 has 3.84kWh to power your family's needs for one day. If that's not enough, add up to six battery packs to expand capacity to 26.9kWh. That's enough power for a week.

bullets.title: Long-Lasting 10-Year Lifespan
bullets.text: Anker SOLIX F3800 is built to last over a decade, even with everyday use, thanks to Anker InfiniPower technology. The power station also features EV-class LFP batteries, durable components, and a smart temperature control system.

bullets.title: Peace of Mind with 5-Year Warranty
bullets.text: Instead of the average industry warranty length of 2 years, you can purchase Anker SOLIX F3800 Portable Power Station Expansion Battery worry-free with a 5-year full-device warranty.

bullets.title: Groundbreaking Floor Washing System
bullets.text: Introducing the revolutionary Floor Washing System, equipped with an Always Clean Mop and a dual water reservoir loaded with ozonated water. The 11.4-inch mop refreshed itself in real-time at 170 RPM, ensuring all-around cleanliness by removing even invisible dirt. And with 1 kg of downward pressure, S1 Pro mimics meticulous hand scrubbing to effectively remove stubborn stains*. *We do not recommend cleaning large amounts of liquid waste, as there is a risk of damaging the robot.

bullets.title: 10-in-1 UniClean Station
bullets.text: Offers auto emptying, auto washing, auto refilling, auto heated air drying, Eco-Clean Ozone, auto waste water collection, auto detergent dispensing, LCD touch control, sealed dust bag and 20% faster charging*. Enjoy hassle-free cleaning with this 10-in-1 powerhouse, for automated and effortless maintenance. *Based on eufy internal test, 20% faster charging compared to the previous generation product.

bullets.title: 8,000 Pa Potent Suction
bullets.text: empowers deep cleaning on carpets and hard floors, effortlessly removing hair and deep-seated dirt*. *Actual performance may vary based on the floor type and dust level.

bullets.title: Constructed for Corner-to-Edge Cleaning
bullets.text: S1 Pro's sleek square design ensures it effortlessly reaches hard-to-reach areas like edges and corners for a thorough deep clean.

bullets.title: The Sports Car Streamlined Build
bullets.text: Inspired by the sleek and graceful lines of elite sports cars, this is more than just a home appliance; it also elevates your living space.
